code='''def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    color = next(v for row in g for v in row if v not in (0, 1))
    pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] == color]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in pts)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in pts)
    shape = [(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in pts]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            cells = [(r+dr, c+dc) for dr, dc in shape]
            if all(0 <= a < h and 0 <= b < w and g[a][b] in (0, color) for a, b in cells):
                for a, b in cells:
                    g[a][b] = color
    return g
'''
